principle: Each surface answers one question. A command has one canonical owner and is not duplicated as a competing primary action.

decisions.finalPlacement: Secondary action below the actual artifact preview
decisions.reason: Users need bounded personalization before save.

decisions.to: Contextual sheet opened from a preview row
decisions.reason: It changes only a personal proposal and does not require a full editor.

decisions.from: Immediate save CTA before destination certainty
decisions.reason: The user should see artifact name, count, and losses first.
Public export owns whole Flow only and must match the preview artifact.

decisions.finalPlacement: Single primary action: 저장한 전체 Flow 보기
decisions.reason: The receipt confirms the saved object; it should not force an execution decision.
It competes with whole-plan verification and opens a detail sheet without completion.
The duplicate post-save hub should not exist.
Calendar remains a persistent top-level lens and does not need to compete in a second receipt.
Export belongs to public preflight or the personal Flow workspace.

decisions.finalPlacement: One command per compact library row
decisions.reason: The library owns selection, not execution.
Routine is a Flow property, not a lifecycle state.
Replace it with a shape-aware execution unit at the top of the same Flow.

decisions.to: Persistent whole-plan section below the shape-aware execution unit
decisions.reason: Plan context should not disappear when the user executes.
Empty current-run copy is not an independent object or destination.

decisions.to: Optional disclosure shown only when execution events exist
decisions.reason: History owns completion, reopen, skip, and hold events only.

decisions.to: Same completion primitive inside Item detail and row
decisions.reason: Opening an Item must not remove the ability to execute it.
Current scope belongs to the selected Item context.
Whole and selected scopes belong to the personal Flow object.
Calendar is a dated lens and routes execution back to the owning Flow.

decisions.from: Below the complete month grid on mobile
decisions.to: Mobile bottom sheet; retain wide side agenda
decisions.reason: The selected day must remain spatially connected to the date tap.
